fullPassage: People often think that they can accomplish more than they actually end up accomplishing, and that any costs incurred will be as expected. In reality, many of us fall short of our work goal. And, budget overruns are a common feature of large public projects. The Sydney Opera House, for instance, was supposed to be completed in 1963 at a cost of $7 million. Instead, it was finished 10 years later at a cost of $102 million. Such lack of realism is not without cost. The inability to meet one's goals can lead to disappointment, loss of self-esteem, and reduced social regard. Also, time and money can be wasted pursuing unrealistic goals. Think of someone enrolling in a program of study that to neutral observers is beyond his capability. Should he fail, a significant amount of time and money will have been wasted. And, because of disappointment, he might be hesitant in the future to strive for other goals that are truly within his grasp.

questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B) 두 문장에서 밑줄 친 cost의 의미로 가장 적절한 것을 각각 고르시오. (B)에 해당하는 것은?

det.korean: (A) cost = 비용/경비, (B) cost = 대가/희생
det.analysis:
① 비용, 경비: (A) 문맥에 해당 — 700만 달러의 '비용'으로 완공될 예정이었다

✅ ② 대가, 희생: (B) 문맥에 해당 — 현실성의 부재는 '대가' 없이 끝나지 않는다. 실망과 자존감 상실이라는 '대가'를 치른다 ←정답

③ 가격, 값: (A)와 유사하나 상품 거래 맥락에 더 적합

④ 원가, 생산비: 제조업 맥락에 한정된 의미

questions.passage: People often think that they can accomplish more than they actually end up accomplishing, and that any costs incurred will be as expected. In reality, many of us fall short of our work goal. And, budget overruns are a common feature of large public projects. The Sydney Opera House, __________, was supposed to be completed in 1963 at a cost of $7 million. Instead, it was finished 10 years later at a cost of $102 million. Such lack of realism is not without cost. The inability to meet one's goals can lead to disappointment, loss of self-esteem, and reduced social regard. Also, time and money can be wasted pursuing unrealistic goals. Think of someone enrolling in a program of study that to neutral observers is beyond his capability. Should he fail, a significant amount of time and money will have been wasted. And, because of disappointment, he might be hesitant in the future to strive for other goals that are truly within his grasp.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: for instance(예를 들어): 시드니 오페라 하우스는 예산 초과의 예시이다
det.analysis:
❌ ① in contrast(대조적으로): 앞 문장과 대조 관계가 아닌 예시 관계
❌ ② as a result(결과적으로): 인과 관계가 아닌 예시 관계
✅ ③ for instance(예를 들어): 대규모 공공사업의 예산 초과 → 시드니 오페라 하우스가 구체적 예시 ←정답
❌ ④ in addition(게다가): 추가 정보가 아닌 예시 관계
det.tip: for instance = for example = 예를 들어

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: within his grasp(그의 손에 닿는 곳에 있는): 진정으로 달성 가능한 다른 목표
det.analysis:
✅ ① within his grasp(손에 닿는 곳에 있는): 실패 후 주저하게 되어 진정으로 달성 '가능한' 목표마저 포기하게 된다는 맥락과 일치 ←정답
❌ ② out of his mind(제정신이 아닌): 관용구이나 문맥 무관
❌ ③ beyond his reach(손이 닿지 않는): within his grasp의 반의어 — 능력 밖의 목표는 앞 문장에서 이미 언급
❌ ④ against his will(그의 의지에 반하여): 문맥 무관
det.tip: within one's grasp = 손에 닿는 곳에 있는, 달성 가능한
